// diagnostic

E1124

Case `{case_name}` of `{enum_name}` states no number.

What

Case `{case_name}` of `{enum_name}` states no number.

Why

`#Specified` makes every case of `{enum_name}` state its number, so adding or moving a case renumbers no other.

Fix

Write the case's number, such as `{case_name} = 0`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1124: tests/ui/enum_specified_refusals.stderr.

Error [jet.SpecifiedCaseUnnumbered]: Case `Sub` of `Op` states no number
  --> tests/ui/enum_specified_refusals.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     Sub
    |     ^^^
 Why: `#Specified` makes every case of `Op` state its number, so adding or moving a case renumbers no other
 Fix: Write the number: `Sub = 2`

Error [jet.SpecifiedWithoutNumbers]: `#Specified` is on enum `Mode`, whose cases have no numbers
  --> tests/ui/enum_specified_refusals.jet:9:1
    |
  9 | #Specified
    | ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#Specified` makes every case of a numbered enum state its number, and only a `#Layout(U8)`-style or `#Layout(c)` enum numbers its cases
 Fix: Number the cases with a backing such as `#Layout(U8)`, or remove `#Specified`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1125
